gloss: to relate; to associate; to connect

definitions.gloss: to relate; to associate; to connect (one thing with another)
definitions.explanation: To draw or establish a logical connection between two or more things, especially when analyzing, explaining, or thinking critically about how they are related.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事例|じれい}→事例：11417_jirei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧づけた。
examples.english: I connected this incident with past cases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{実践|じっせん}→実践：08241_jissen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧づけて⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Think by connecting theory and practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧な⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧づけて⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please explain it in relation to its historical background.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧ (relation, connection) and the verb-forming suffix づける. Used when drawing connections or establishing relationships between separate things, especially in analytical, academic, or explanatory contexts.

USAGE:
The pattern is: A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{関連|かんれん}づける (to connect A with B). Can also use ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ instead of ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{関連|かんれん}づける: to relate to ~
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧づけて⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to think in connection with ~
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{関連|かんれん}づける: to connect pieces of knowledge
- ⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{関連|かんれん}づける: to connect with a cause

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{結|むす}びつける→結びつく：13797_musubitsuku⟧: to tie together, to link — more concrete, emphasizes binding
- ⟦{関連|かんれん}する→関連する：17848_kanrensuru⟧: to be related — intransitive, describes an existing connection
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧づける: to relate — very similar, sometimes interchangeable
